claims.note: The page states the end date.

claims.claim: Former claimants should check the Annual Review letter for their final award.
claims.quote: You’ll need to check that the information in the letter is correct (known as ‘finalising’ your tax credits).
claims.note: The page says to check the Annual Review information to finalise tax credits.

claims.claim: If Annual Review information is wrong, claimants must contact HMRC by the deadline in the letter.
claims.quote: If you think there’s a mistake or your personal details are wrong, contact HM Revenue and Customs ( HMRC ) to report it. You need to do this by the deadline written in your Annual Review letter.
claims.note: The page states both the correction step and its deadline.

claims.claim: Universal Credit or Pension Credit may be available instead of tax credits.
claims.quote: You may be able to get Universal Credit or Pension Credit instead.
claims.note: The page names both possible alternatives.

claims.claim: The person received tax credits before they ended.
claims.quote: You’ll get a letter called your Annual Review when your tax credits award ends.
claims.note: The page addresses people whose tax credits award ended, but it does not require that they actually received payments.

claims.claim: The person has an Annual Review letter to check.
claims.quote: You’ll get a letter called your Annual Review when your tax credits award ends.
claims.note: The page states that former award holders receive the letter.

claims.claim: A claimant can finalise a tax credits award by phone.
claims.quote: Call HMRC: if you have a general enquiry about your tax credits
claims.note: The contact page allows tax credits enquiries by phone but does not expressly say Annual Review corrections can be reported that way.

claims.claim: A claimant can finalise a tax credits award by post.
claims.quote: Send complaints or changes in your circumstances to this address.
claims.note: The contact page accepts changes of circumstances by post but does not expressly cover Annual Review corrections.
